claims.answer: Browser chat interface on the Coder dashboard Agents page plus an HTTP API and an experimental coder exp chat CLI; the coder CLI installs on Linux, macOS and Windows. There is no native desktop or mobile app for Agents and no Agents-specific editor extension; developers use their usual editor against the workspaces the agent produces.

evidence.title: Coder Agents overview
evidence.locator: index.md How it works; Built-in tools; Plan mode; LLM providers; Security benefits
evidence.finding: Chat interface and API for delegating work to a self-hosted Go agent that runs inside the Coder control plane; workspaces provisioned automatically from templates; sub-agents; queueing; attachments; providers Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Azure, Bedrock, OpenAI-compatible, OpenRouter, Vercel; no SaaS component.

evidence.title: Coder Agents architecture
evidence.finding: Agent loop in control plane; chat state in the database; context compaction (/compact); actions attributed to the submitting user.

evidence.title: Coder Agents licensing and usage
evidence.locator: Community and Premium licenses; AI Premium; Agent Time; usage reporting
evidence.finding: Community and Premium: up to five concurrently active agents deployment-wide, queued beyond; AI Premium: unlimited concurrent agents against purchased Agent Hours; usage hours reported to Coder Tallyman/Metronome without chat data.

evidence.title: Getting started
evidence.finding: Admin configures an LLM provider and model per organization; needs a template; every org member can use Agents by default; CI/webhook triggering listed as API use.

evidence.title: Models
evidence.locator: Model configuration; user API keys (BYOK); personal model overrides
evidence.finding: Admin-managed providers and per-organization models; optional user API keys per provider; model identifiers such as claude-opus-4-6 and gpt-5.3-codex.

evidence.title: Platform controls
evidence.locator: Design philosophy; Providers and models; System prompt
evidence.finding: All agent configuration is admin-level and enforced server-side; templates, MCP servers, retention and budgets controlled centrally.

evidence.title: Spend management
evidence.finding: Per-user and group monthly budgets enforced through AI Gateway (requires entitlement); native cost tracking removed; limit cap $1,000,000 per member per period.

evidence.title: Network isolation
evidence.locator: How it works; Configure the template
evidence.finding: Template-defined separate pod for the agent with network policy; early stage; user pod unrestricted; bubblewrap suggested as alternative.

evidence.title: ACP subagents
evidence.finding: Experimental: with chat-acp-subagents experiment, external harnesses such as Claude Code or Codex run as ACP subagents in the workspace, using the harness own credentials; tool permission requests auto-approved; not in plan mode.

evidence.title: Chat sharing
evidence.locator: Share a chat; Shared chat access
evidence.finding: Share read-only with users or groups; viewers cannot send messages; admins can disable sharing.

evidence.title: Projects
evidence.finding: Early access: project instructions, skills and memory shared across chats; private to owner; changes in audit log.

evidence.title: Extending agents
evidence.locator: Workspace shares context; Where the agent looks
evidence.finding: Workspace agent scans for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, skills and .mcp.json and pushes a snapshot that chats pin; refresh context control.

evidence.title: Conversation data retention
evidence.finding: Archived chats purged after a configurable retention period (default 30 days, can be disabled); auto-archive separate.

evidence.title: Advisor
evidence.finding: Experimental chat-advisor lets a root agent request a single-step model call for strategic guidance.

evidence.title: Git providers
evidence.finding: In-chat diff viewer and merge request status use configured external auth for GitHub and GitLab; write_repository scope allows pushing commits and creating merge requests.

evidence.title: Chat search syntax
evidence.finding: Chat search filters include pr_status (draft/open/merged/closed/none) for linked pull requests.

evidence.title: Chat limits
evidence.finding: Deployment chat limits: MaxStepsPerTurn, MaxGenerationRetries, MaxQueuedMessagesPerChat, MaxAttachmentsPerChat, MaxPromptBytes, MaxConcurrentRecordingUploads, configurable through deployment options.

evidence.title: LLM retry logic
evidence.finding: Transient provider errors are classified (overloaded, rate limit, timeout, stream silence timeout, usage limit, auth, config) and retried with exponential backoff from 1s capped at 60s, honoring provider retry hints.

evidence.title: execute tool
evidence.finding: The execute tool waits 10s by default (timeout argument up to the caller), supports run_in_background and a wait_timeout override; no approval prompt appears in the tool.

evidence.title: Agents page mobile handling
evidence.locator: site/src/pages/AgentsPage/hooks/useConversationEditingState.ts lines 3 and 137; useAgentChatPanelPreference.ts line 2; 91 sm:/md:/lg: Tailwind class uses across AgentsPage (rg -c)
evidence.finding: The Agents page imports isMobileViewport and useMediaQuery and applies responsive classes, so the web UI adapts to narrow viewports in code; no documentation states supported phone browsers.

evidence.title: chatd architecture notes
evidence.finding: Receivers must tolerate duplicate pubsub deliveries and the run loop deduplicates state updates; duplicate execution of tool calls after an interruption is not addressed.

evidence.title: Agent loop and sub-agents in chatd
evidence.finding: chatd implements spawn_agent sub-agents, ACP integration and admission control with default 5 concurrent root agents and 10 concurrent subagents.

evidence.title: Chat HTTP routes
evidence.finding: Authenticated REST endpoints under /api/v2/chats for list, create, watch, files, projects and model configs.

evidence.title: coder exp chat CLI
evidence.finding: coder CLI exposes experimental chat and workspace-context subcommands.

evidence.title: Deployment feature flags
evidence.finding: License features include agent_runtime_hours and ai_governance_user_limit for Agent Time and AI governance.

evidence.title: AGPL-3.0 license
evidence.finding: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 at the repository root.

evidence.title: Enterprise license
evidence.finding: Enterprise-licensed code lives under enterprise/ (aiseats, audit, ai-gateway); core under AGPL-3.0.

evidence.title: Telemetry
evidence.finding: Coder collects telemetry from installations by default; CODER_TELEMETRY_ENABLE=false disables it.

evidence.title: Coder MCP server
evidence.finding: Built-in MCP server (stdio via CLI and remote HTTP with OAuth2) exposing workspace and template tools to other AI assistants.

evidence.title: Bring your own MCP servers
evidence.finding: Agents can use admin-approved external MCP servers and workspace .mcp.json servers.

evidence.title: Agent Relay
evidence.finding: Beta Premium feature connecting a cloud-hosted coding agent session to self-hosted Coder workspaces.

evidence.title: AI Gateway
evidence.finding: Gateway for governing and metering model traffic with budgets and audit; entitlement-gated.

evidence.title: Coder pricing
evidence.finding: Community free (up to 5 active Coder Agents, AI Governance); Premium priced annually per user with no amount shown (adds Coder Agents, HA, audit logging, multi-org RBAC, OIDC sync, SLA); AI Premium custom (unlimited active agents, Coder Agents API for headless agents, network-isolated agent workspaces).

evidence.title: Install the Coder CLI
evidence.finding: Coder CLI installs on Linux, macOS and Windows; the control plane installs on Linux, Kubernetes and other hosts.

evidence.title: In the IDE
evidence.finding: Workspaces support IDE agents (Cursor, Copilot, Roo and others); developers connect via VS Code, JetBrains and other editors to review agent output.

evidence.title: OIDC authentication
evidence.finding: OIDC login documented for the Coder dashboard; group/role sync is a Premium feature (idp-sync).

evidence.title: GitHub repository metadata
evidence.finding: 17,395 stars on 2026-11-16; AGPL-3.0; not archived; pushed 2026-11-16.

evidence.title: Coder v2.39.4 release
evidence.finding: Latest stable patch release at pass time; v2.39.x line current.

evidence.title: Tasks to chats migration
evidence.finding: Coder Tasks (earlier agent task feature) are migrated to Coder Agents chats; tasks are not a separate issue tracker.

evidence.title: Audit logs
evidence.finding: Premium audit log records user actions in the deployment, including project and chat configuration changes.
